<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy and Growth:</strong> The RBI has kept the repo rate unchanged while projecting a real GDP growth of 6.9% for the current fiscal year.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty declined for the second consecutive day, pressured by a sell-off in IT, auto, and private banking stocks amid rising crude oil prices and West Asia instability.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Liquidity and Currency:</strong> The rupee remains under pressure in the mid-94 range as the RBI manages a liquidity surplus through VRRR operations, while inflation risks continue to impact bond yields.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxNWEFWWEFkbzNjRDVmVXgzX0tWQ00zUThLMzZiU3pGR1ZPTDJqWDRCVXowbHRfcXh3OXFTVTZ6SVFFcXhXR2FaUzRlZ0M2VFZXc3MxQjVacDJQcTRPZXNXRnVfcUFNbE1nLWoxc2RpM003cjU3ZTJEekg2QkNJX1NqT0Y5YTVrUTU3S05nanFxaS1QZE4tV0wtbjl6c0VZblFkS1ZndmctaDU3bDNhTmlpYnE3QjNSQ21wRWVxUmVxdTk0ZTFOUTd0VUZUYmw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude Oil Impact:</strong> Brent crude nearing $97 per barrel remains the primary headwind for Indian equities, overshadowing domestic policy cues and fueling market volatility.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi--?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
